verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing platform, so per-card and per-cardholder spend limits are a fair question. The evidence pack does not document amount caps over daily, monthly or all-time windows, or transaction-count velocity rules. The nearest items are adjacent controls: merchant/category blocking, a 3DS rule that forces a challenge above an amount threshold, and credit-line lifecycle management. None of these are platform-enforced spend limits.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set spend limits per card and per cardholder — amount caps over daily, monthly, or all-time windows, and transaction-count velocity rules — enforced by the platform, not my code
